html:
The Bahrain Grand Prix is a Formula One race held at the Sakhir circuit in the desert of Bahrain. The first, in April 2004, was the first Formula One race in the Middle East.

It was the start of a strategy that its neighbours soon copied: hosting world sport to put a small state on the map. Abu Dhabi got its own race in 2009, and Qatar won the 2022 World Cup.

The race was cancelled in 2011 during the uprising, and its return in 2012 drew protests. Since 2014 it has been run at night under floodlights. It stands for the push of Bahrain to live on services after oil.
